name: Social posting

does: Writes short public posts from the organization's own published claims that are fresh, each sentence tied to a claim id
Checks every draft with a separate checker before it is queued, and rejects unbacked sentences, undated numbers and links off the allowlist
Publishes approved posts to the configured account on Bluesky or through a scheduler, within a daily and a weekly cap
Reads each post back to confirm it is live, and reads engagement to score its own predictions
does_not: Impersonate a person or post as one: every post comes from the organization's own configured account
Buy engagement, followers or reposts, or use fake accounts
Mass-follow, mass-like or auto-reply to strangers
Post any fact that is not a fresh public claim in the registry
Bypass the outbound guard, the caps or a kill switch

charter.objective: Publish accurate, claim-backed public posts and confirm each one is live, without a single removed or unbacked post

primary_metric.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM social_queue WHERE status = 'published' AND verify_status = 'verified' AND published_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

guard_metrics.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM social_queue WHERE status = 'removed' AND removed_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM guard_ledger WHERE pack = 'social' AND decision = 'refused' AND at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

enable_gate: Turn on Social posting? It will write short public posts from the organization's own published, fresh claims, check each one, and post up to 2 a day and 8 a week to the account you configure (Bluesky or a scheduler). Until it has earned trust, every post waits here as a card with its full text for you to approve. It will not pretend to be a person, buy engagement or followers, mass-follow, or post any fact that is not a fresh claim. It costs only the model calls you allow for phrasing, which can be none. Turn it off any time with one action.
